_review.scope: BRIEF-10.md Part 5 only: 78 wasteland street/city/slums/industry summer and winter files.
_review.calibration: Ship beside approved art, allowing purposeful weathering and minor irregularities. Failed noise is localized where it obscures structure; no universal rejection of textured pixel art. Passes retain readable silhouettes, planes and openings in native-size planted and randomized layouts.
_review.previous_review: critic-r105-0.json absent at start of review.
references: art-drop/BRIEF-10.md Part 5 and shared built-up/QC rules
art-drop/BRIEF-8.md prop-placement approach referenced by BRIEF-10
art-drop/reference/wasteland-marker0.png through wasteland-marker3.png; no wasteland-house.png exists
Approved round-2 city, slums, industry, suburb and farmland samples in out/
Approved grass/plains bases and details, including spring/autumn/winter comparisons in out/
_review.not_applicable: Part 5 has no mountain peaks, crater tiles, tree/forest assets or autumn variants. Peak lattice/range, forest planting, egg-crate peaks, Swiss-cheese craters, stamped cyberpunk grid, flat autumn and identical crowns therefore are outside this review, not silently reviewed as passes.
general_findings: All 78 files present; all dimensions correct. All 76 sprite alpha channels contain only 0/255. Bottom bounds are on the penultimate image row and horizontal centring is appropriate.

No translucent fringe/halo, uniform reversed light direction or near-duplicate silhouette found. Warm rust/tan/grey palette is compatible in principle; the failed assets need clearer material boundaries and pixel clusters, rather than a blanket palette replacement.
No literal blur filter is asserted from palette counts: the cited muddy forms result from fragmented shading/dithering.
Snow exists on every winter sprite. Sprite failures identify architectural readability problems, with any extra winter fragmentation named explicitly.
Street and one-cell composites do not show a cell-border frame or stamped pavement grid. Reusing a sprite in a random-layout test is not counted as a near-duplicate asset.
